text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Book(x) ∧ Novel(x)) → (Writer(y) ∧ Wrote(y, x))) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Wrote(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ Book(familyHistory) ∧ Publish(year2003, familyHistory) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003 by Dani Shapiro.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
American(boston) ∧ City(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
